scope: Rootless native video + commands + sensors, shared A/C/B relay packet blackholes
limitations: No bandwidth shaping or different route RTT; not the privileged three-path emulator
UDP packet blackhole, not interface-down, socket failure or SSH/network reconfiguration
Synthetic native video, not hardware camera or screen/glass-to-glass timing
Command receipt is acceptance, not actuator execution or crash-persistent exactly-once
Same Pi/process clock; test-relay/logging overhead included in observed timings
One short functional run, no CPU/RSS benchmark or SRT/DDS superiority claim
